description: Hi I’m Biruk, a Grade 11 Natural Science student & web developer (HTML/CSS/JS) passionate about space tech and physics. For the Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer challenge, I'm building a playable browser simulation game on managing life support and space hazards. Open to 100% remote teammates—join us for an organized, async-friendly build! Seeking skills in UI/Graphic Design, NASA/Space Research, Scenario Writing, or Video Pitching.
